snippet.title: Paranormal Pup! | "PLAY DEAD! #1" | Horror Game Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Welcome to "Play Dead! #1", Schrodinger's House.

The is a visual novel about a band, their junky, broken down van, an abandoned house, and a surprisingly lively dead dog.

Content warning for profanity, cartoon violence, bones and other mentions of death, loud noises, and kinda gross monsters.

This is a kinetic novel, so there are no choices to make or alternate endings to unlock. Just grab some popcorn, sit back, and enjoy the story.

Enjoy!
